description: Election Commission - Registration of Electors (Special Provisions) Act, No. 10 of 2017 (Internally Displaced)
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses electoral processes under the Registration of Electors Act, detailing procedures for internally displaced persons and their children to register for voting. It announces the timeline for receiving applications for supplementary voter registration, outlines eligibility criteria, and is issued by the Election Commission. This content directly relates to voter registration matters, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
